name: Git Repository Read/Write Coordination
purpose: Coordinate deterministic, authorized Git repository reads and bounded writes for verified repairs.
required_inputs: T20 VERIFIED repair result for repair commits

deep_audit.02_capability_completeness: Read, baseline verification, scoped staging, commit and optional push.
deep_audit.03_inputs: Repository state, authorization, verified repair and bounded paths.
deep_audit.04_outputs: Git transaction result and immutable transaction fingerprint.
deep_audit.05_state_dependency: T03 state is read-only evidence only.
deep_audit.06_evidence_dependency: T18 authorization and T20 verified repair are required for repair writes.
deep_audit.08_downstream_consumers: Future PR, deployment, release and audit layers.
deep_audit.09_failure_modes: Dirty tree, branch drift, HEAD drift, scope mismatch, commit failure and push failure.
deep_audit.11_determinism: Repository fingerprints and transaction inputs are canonicalized.
deep_audit.12_concurrency: One active write transaction per repository.
deep_audit.13_recovery: Pre-commit failures are safely aborted; committed history is never destructively rewritten.
deep_audit.14_gpt_limitation_coverage: Prevents stale context, wrong branch, wrong files and false Git success claims.
deep_audit.15_new_agent_usability: Machine-readable Git transaction request and receipt.
deep_audit.17_read_capability: Git status, HEAD, branch, diff, log, remote and refs.
deep_audit.18_write_capability: Only explicit scoped branch, stage, commit and authorized push.
deep_audit.19_testability: Temporary Git repositories provide deterministic isolated tests.
deep_audit.20_observability: Before/after repository identities and commit evidence.
deep_audit.21_integration_contract: T20 VERIFIED repair becomes a T21 Git transaction.
deep_audit.22_missing_layers: PR, release and deployment remain downstream.
deep_audit.24_idempotency_replay_safety: Repair and transaction fingerprints prevent duplicate commits.
deep_audit.26_adversarial_red_team_coverage: Force push, path escape, staging bypass and branch drift are blocked.
